content.title: Shelters, Pergolas & Shade Structures
content.description:
Create a Comfortable Outdoor Space for Every Season

Enhance your outdoor living area with a custom shelter, pergola, or shade structure designed for comfort, durability, and style. Maxima Concrete combines premium materials, expert craftsmanship, and precision installation to create functional outdoor spaces that provide protection from the elements while complementing your patio and landscape.

Every structure is custom-built to fit your space, lifestyle, and outdoor design. Using proven construction methods and quality materials, we create durable, low-maintenance shade solutions that expand your outdoor living area and provide lasting comfort through Ohio’s changing seasons.

items.question: What types of shelters do you build?
items.answer: We build pavilions, pergolas, and covered outdoor structures on durable concrete or paver foundations.

items.question: Are shelters built to withstand Ohio weather?
items.answer: Yes. We use weather-resistant materials and solid foundations so your shelter lasts for years.

items.question: Can a shelter be added to my existing patio?
items.answer: In many cases, yes. We'll assess your space and design a shelter that fits your layout.

items.question: Do you offer financing?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment options.
